title: Israel’s Parties Gird for Wrangling to Form a Government, With No Clear Path
summary_full: Votes are still being counted, but it appears that neither Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu’s right-wing coalition nor the opposition alliance headed by Gadi Eisenkot will have a majority.
